*[Reasoning in the farmer's own voice]*

Aiya, let me think about this year. My 4.1 mu, half wheat half maize like always — that's what works on this land, that's what my mother-in-law did, that's what everyone in the village does. Last year the wheat came out alright, maybe 400 kg per mu, the maize did a bit better, maybe 450. Not bad, not great. Nothing broke this year so I'll do it pretty much the same way.

The wheat is already in the ground — I planted it in October, right after the maize came off. I used the seed I bought at the agricultural store, same kind as last year, about 15 jin per mu, I don't remember exactly how much. For base fertilizer I put down one bag of compound fertilizer per mu — that's 40 kg bag, the 15-15-15 kind, costs about 170 yuan a bag. My husband helped me spread it before the rotavator went through. Now after Spring Festival, when the wheat starts waking up and turning green, I'll put down urea — maybe half a bag per mu, like I always do. If it looks yellow I'll add a bit more, if it looks good I won't waste money. I'll water it maybe two times, once at returning green, once at heading if there's no rain. The well water is costing more now, so I don't want to water too much.

For maize, after I cut the wheat in June I have to get the seed in fast — maybe three, four days window, can't waste time. I'll buy Zhengdan hybrid seed again, the one the agricultural store man recommended two years ago, it's done well for me. I put fertilizer down when I plant — one bag compound fertilizer for every mu and a half or so, I stretch it a bit because maize is cheaper to grow. Then when the maize is knee-high I'll scatter some urea between the rows, maybe 15 kg per mu. Maize doesn't need much water if the summer rain comes — last year I only watered once. If this summer is dry I'll water two times.

I don't hire anyone except the combine harvester for the wheat — that's 60 yuan per mu, faster than cutting by hand and I can't do 4 mu alone with just a sickle. The maize I pick by hand, my husband helps on weekends when he's back from the town. My two kids help during school holidays. For pesticide I spray herbicide on the wheat after the spring when the weeds come up, and if there's aphids I spray once. Maize I usually spray one herbicide after planting, that's it. I don't need much pesticide, my land isn't big.

I don't have a lot of cash to play with. Four mu can't feed us all — my husband brings home wages from working construction in town, that's what pays for the kids' school. The farm is mostly for our own grain and some extra to sell. I don't want to spend too much on fertilizer. If I spend 200 yuan more per mu I won't get 200 yuan more back, that's what I've seen. Better to keep the money for when we need it.
